title: Make grid columns
summary: A grid can arrange boxes in rows and columns.
introduction: A grid can arrange boxes in rows and columns. Your task: Change grid-cols-2 to grid-cols-4.
learningObjectives: Explain the example for make grid columns

blocks.text: A grid can arrange boxes in rows and columns. The number in grid-cols tells Tailwind how many equal columns to create.

These examples use Tailwind CSS 4 in a separate project. Install tailwindcss and @tailwindcss/cli. Put @import "tailwindcss"; in input.css and build with npx @tailwindcss/cli -i input.css -o output.css. Link output.css in HTML.
Read the code step by step

items: `p-4` adds inner space using Tailwind's spacing scale. It is a scale step rather than four pixels.
`grid-cols-2` defines two grid columns. The `grid` class is also needed to make a grid layout.

blocks.text: Four items form two rows with two columns each.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Add grid as well as grid-cols-2. The column setting needs a grid layout to act on.
